scope: Freeze two independently designed Relics beside Threadball
Introduce a deterministic artillery v2 replay ABI while preserving v1 reconstruction
Extend strict snapshots and Loomkeeper candidate evaluation to all three Relics
Add parity, bounds, edge-case, compatibility, and golden replay evidence
non_goals: Phone combat controls or Phaser presentation
Production Relic artwork, audio, or asset imports
Nimiq wallet signatures, reward reservations, claims, or payouts
PvP matchmaking or Calling-specific gameplay statistics
skipped_checks: Physical Android and iOS testing: no release-testing environment was provided.
Nimiq Pay WebView and real wallet-provider testing: deferred to the external release environment and WP-012.
Relic phone UI and production art/audio: owned by WP-010 and WP-015; this slice uses gameplay data only.
residual_risks: Relic balance constants are frozen v2 replay ABI; later balance changes require a new ruleset identifier.
The public createSimulation helper defaults to v1 for compatibility; new authoritative callers must use createLatestSimulation or the coordinator default.
The bounded Loomkeeper sampler covers every candidate axis but intentionally evaluates only a deterministic subset of cross-product combinations.
Authoritative state and replay remain single-process and restart-sensitive until durable hosting work is implemented.
The client bundle is approximately 1.346 MB minified and 371.7 kB gzip and retains the existing chunk-size warning.
